socio.title: Sociological Crime Insights & Policy Platform
socio.description: Place-level criminological analytics grounded in Social Disorganization Theory (Shaw & McKay). District aggregate indicators are strictly firewalled from individual person records.

metrics.compositeStressScoreInfo: Composite measure of socioeconomic stress including poverty, unemployment, and family instability indicators
metrics.literacyRateInfo: Percentage of population with basic literacy skills in the district
metrics.unemploymentRateInfo: Percentage of workforce actively seeking employment but unable to find work
metrics.urbanizationLevelInfo: Percentage of population living in urban areas versus rural

socio.noIndicatorData: No indicator data available for this district
socio.noGwrData: No GWR runs available for this district
socio.insufficientData: Not enough data for a correlation matrix

financial.title: Financial Crime Detection
financial.subtitle: Transaction Typology Analysis
financial.pickPersonDesc: See the accounts tied to them, then scan for typologies.
financial.noLinkedAccountsDesc: This person has no transactions on record to scan.
financial.noAlertTriggeredDesc: This account doesn't match a known typology pattern.
financial.noTypologyMatched: No typology matched any of these accounts.

trends.title: Crime Trends & Hotspot Forecast
trends.description: Hawkes/ETAS self-exciting forecast, real temporal seasonality, MO-linkage series, and forecast-derived surveillance priorities — decomposed into chronic background risk and acute near-repeat risk.
trends.noForecastYetDesc: Run a forecast to see the hotspot map for this district and crime type.
trends.notEnoughCaseDataDesc: This district/crime-type combination has no dated cases yet.
trends.noMoSeriesDesc: No candidate same-offender series above the similarity threshold for this crime type.
trends.survRankingDesc: Top-risk grid cells from the real hotspot forecast, ranked. Not a patrol shift roster — no beat, shift, or unit-coverage data exists in this system to base one on; this ranks and labels real forecast output.
trends.noRankingYetDesc: Rank priorities to see the top-risk checkpoints for this district and crime type.

cases.title: Case Register
cases.noCaptionDesc: Cases reported within your jurisdiction will appear here as they're registered.

risk.title: Risk Profiling
risk.description: Central-Eight-informed, CHI-weighted risk assessment for investigative attention only — never a standalone decision. Protected demographic attributes are never used as model features.
risk.assessmentDesc: Pick a person to compute their risk profile for investigative guidance.
